Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 9: the slip of [[Jeroen Webb (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“If deploying to opponent's mobile site, deploys -2 as an Undercover spy. Nevar Yalnal may not target spies here. Opponent's total influence here is -1 for each of your spies at sites.”), word for word the text of [[Jeroen Webb (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
